reference: She promised that she would avoid that street again.
sk: Sľúbila, že sa tej ulici vyhne
cz: Slíbila, že se té ulici vyhne
acceptable: She promised {that |}she would {avoid|stay away from|keep away from} {that|the} street{ again|}.
She promised {that |}she was going to {avoid|stay away from} {that|the} street{ again|}.

mistakes.text: She promised {that |}she will avoid that street{ again|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po minulom „promised“ sa budúcnosť posúva do minulosti: „will“ sa mení na „would“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po minulém „promised“ se budoucnost posouvá do minulosti: „will“ se mění na „would“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After the past verb “promised”, “will” moves back to “would”: “she would avoid”.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Sľub sa týka neskoršieho deja z pohľadu minulosti, preto treba „would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Slib se týká pozdějšího děje z pohledu minulosti, proto je potřeba „would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The promise is about a later action, so use Future in the Past: “would avoid”.

mistakes.text: She promised {that |}she would {avoided|avoiding} that street{ again|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „would“ patrí základný tvar slovesa: „would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „would“ patří základní tvar slovesa: „would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “would” use the base form of the verb: “would avoid”.

mistakes.text: She promised {that |}she would to avoid that street{ again|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „would“ sa „to“ nepíše, nasleduje priamo sloveso: „would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „would“ se „to“ nepíše, následuje přímo sloveso: „would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Would” is followed by the verb without “to”: “would avoid”.

mistakes.text: She promised to avoid {that|the} street{ again|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tu sa precvičuje Future in the Past: „promised that she would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tady se procvičuje Future in the Past: „promised that she would avoid“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises Future in the Past: “promised that she would avoid”.

source_issues: SK/CZ have no word for 'again' and no final full stop; translations with and without 'again' accepted.
